summary: {member} points an artist toward privately issued tokens from the years the coin will recall.
realLife: Members suggested that artists working on the Jackson and Van Buren reverses consult the Hard Times tokens that circulated in that era.
inGame: needs: the issue year and an inventory of period references.

turns.pulledBy: The local collection has a token from the period.
turns.what: The artist borrows a photograph of its face.
turns.writesBack: The photograph goes in the design brief.

turns.pulledBy: The only available token is from a later decade.
turns.what: The artist drops the offered reference.
turns.writesBack: The researcher strikes it from the reference list.
